title: Bitwise ORs of Subarrays
description: Return the number of distinct values that can be formed by bitwise OR of all subarrays of the input array.
pseudocode:
1: res = new Set()
2: cur = new Set()
3: for x in arr:
4:   next_cur = {x}
5:   for val in cur:
6:     next_cur.add(val | x)
7:   cur = next_cur
8:   res.update(cur)
9: return res.size

steps.note: Initialize result set 'res' to store unique OR values.
Initialize next_cur set with the current element 1.
Add current OR results {1} to result set.
Start next_cur with the new element 2.
Perform bitwise OR: 1 | 2 = 3. Add to next_cur.
Update res set with {2, 3}. Total unique values: {1, 2, 3}.
Return final size of the result set.
